title: 长城上的摄影课
title_py: zhǎng chéng shàng de shè yǐng kè
title_en: A photography lesson on the Great Wall

lines.text: 山田一个人去爬长城，爬到最高的地方，想拍一张照片发给家里人。
lines.py: Shān tián yí gè rén qù pá cháng chéng, pá dào zuì gāo de dì fang, xiǎng pāi yì zhāng zhào piàn fā gěi jiā lǐ rén.
lines.en: Yamada goes to climb the Great Wall on her own. When she reaches the highest point, she wants a photo to send to her family.
